name: alivecheck
description: Open-source uptime monitoring for developers and small teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @alivecheck/web dev" "pnpm --filter @alivecheck/api dev" "pnpm --filter @alivecheck/worker dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @alivecheck/db build && pnpm --filter @alivecheck/web build && pnpm --filter @alivecheck/api build && pnpm --filter @alivecheck/worker build
